capabilities: Render a timeline view from a markline code block
Insert a markline code block via a command
Configure timelines with metadata such as age, mentions, and colors
Format dates, date ranges, headers, lists, links, and text styling in timelines
extras: Installation via the BRAT plugin is mentioned. Some metadata features (theme, year-length, date-type, author) are listed as coming soon.
intentEvidence: This is fork of Markline, show timeline view from markdown in Obsidian editor.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn dated Markdown lists into a visual timeline.

relations.evidence: This is fork of Markline, show timeline view from markdown in Obsidian editor.

summary: Markdown timeline renderer that displays a timeline view from dated lists inside a markline code block in the editor.
